all_alarms=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    page = apis.phone.show_alarms(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    all_alarms.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
# find wake-up
wake_alarms=[a for a in all_alarms if a.get('label')=='Wake Up']
print('wake_alarms:', [(a.get('alarm_id'), a.get('time'), a.get('enabled')) for a in wake_alarms])
wake_alarm = wake_alarms[0] if wake_alarms else None
print('wake_alarm_id:', wake_alarm.get('alarm_id') if wake_alarm else None)
# fetch full details
wake_alarm_id = wake_alarm.get('alarm_id')
print('show_alarm_resp:', apis.phone.show_alarm(alarm_id=wake_alarm_id, access_token=access_token))
